pattern_categories.description: Common English dictionary base word concatenated with predictable numerical or symbol affix, with optional leetspeak substitutions.
pattern_categories.rationale: Models the widespread human tendency to satisfy complexity policies by appending numbers or symbols to familiar dictionary roots.

pattern_categories.description: Ascending or descending contiguous sequences from standard numeric (0-9) or alphabetic (a-z) alphabets.
Contiguous horizontal rows from standard QWERTY keyboard layouts.
pattern_categories.rationale: Represents spatial motor memory patterns that bypass random character selection.

pattern_categories.description: Single repeated characters or cyclic repetition of short substrings.
Independently uniform random selection across full 4-class charset (lowercase, uppercase, digits, punctuation) of length 12-20.
pattern_categories.rationale: Acts as empirical negative class ground truth for non-guessable, structurally uncorrelated character sequences.

label_definition.classification_objective: Discriminate structured human-like pattern regularities from high-entropy uniform randomness purely using character n-gram frequencies.

leakage_invariants: No string present in train split may appear in validation or test split
No normalized equivalent may cross split boundaries
Vectorization fitted strictly on train split

limitations: Synthetic generation serves as an empirical pipeline validation benchmark; real-world human password choices are influenced by cultural, temporal, and semantic context not fully captured by synthetic grammars.
The baseline is intended as a scientific comparator for Phase 5 feature fusion, not a production authentication validator.
